summary: Find every nonzero 4-connected multicolor object and process each independently. For each object, compute its bounding box, choose the uniquely most frequent color as the main color and the next color as the marker, replace the bounding-box border with the main color, and clear or mark each interior cell according to nearest-edge distances: mark where vertical and horizontal distances are equal, plus the center-row extension when the interior is wider and center-column extension when it is taller. Preserve all cells outside the current object's box.
